verdict.reason: Both halves of the presence claim check out. The task plan's scope note is present verbatim at docs/tasks/active/20260811-cli-error-envelope-command-todo.md:19-22 and says the hand-rolled emitters in docs.ts/slides.ts/notes.ts, src/docs/import.ts, src/files/* and schema.ts "are the subject of #654/#655 and are left alone here"; the Plan checklist (lines 26-38) likewise covers only formatter.ts, commandPath, threading `this` at outputError call sites, cli.ts preAction, and tests. Yet the new exported builders at packages/cli/src/output/formatter.ts:75 and :94 (documented at :66-73 as existing precisely "because outputError is not the only emitter") are now used at every one of those deferred sites: commands/docs.ts:203 and :269, commands/notes.ts:156/:217, commands/slides.ts:162/:219, commands/schema.ts:41, files/upload.ts:148-229, files/download.ts:64, docs/import.ts:146-276, notes/import.ts:134-220, slides/import.ts:160-328. I read docs.ts:194-213 and schema.ts:34-49 directly and they are exactly the "forwarded upstream body" and "lookup miss" paths the note deferred. The scope note was not updated, while docs/design/cli.md:1035-1039 was updated in the opposite direction ("Every emitter builds it through errorEnvelope / backendErrorEnvelope … outputError included"), naming the same paths — the PR's own documents contradict each other. No refutation ground holds: the code is present as described (not not-present), no guard makes it unreachable, and unrequested scope creep / exceeding a stated scope note is explicitly in this lens's lane with the exact lines cited. Whether the wider envelope unification is defensible for end-to-end "single line" consistency is an author/maintainer judgement I cannot concretely refute.

verdict.reason: The described code is present exactly as claimed: packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts mints a 32-byte nonce (line 42), sends it on the OAuth start URL (line 46), and rejects callbacks whose `state` does not match via constant-time compare (lines 163-169, 203-210); packages/backend/src/auth/cli-auth.store.ts stores and echoes `nonce` (lines 13, 30, 38, 60), with matching references in github-auth.guard.ts/auth.controller.ts and docs/design/cli.md:175-205. The reviewer's evidence about scope also checks out: docs/tasks/active/20260811-cli-error-envelope-command-todo.md:24-47 lists only formatter changes, a commandPath helper, threading `this` at outputError call sites, a cli.ts preAction hook, and tests; its acceptance criteria are single-line envelope, `command` attribution, and unchanged code/message — nothing about CLI login, OAuth, or callback binding. The companion lessons file likewise covers only envelope work, and no task doc anywhere mentions the nonce. Unrequested scope creep is explicitly in this lens's lane and rated major, so out-of-scope does not apply; not-present fails because the code is there; already-guarded is inapplicable to a scope claim. The only possible refutation would be showing the login/nonce work already exists on main rather than in this branch, but the worktree is a detached checkout (HEAD fbfca47 = origin/agent/661-cli-error-envelope-command per .git/packed-refs:6, base main d327ee4 per .git/FETCH_HEAD:1) and I have no tool available to compute that diff. Uncertainty keeps the finding.

verdict.reason: The finding rests on the doc stating an unqualified universal invariant, and that text is not present as quoted. cli.md:1035-1039 actually reads "...so 'one line, attributed' holds ON THE PATHS THAT NEVER THROW EITHER: the import/upload/download orchestrators, the backend-error passthroughs on docs/notes/slides content and export, and schema's lookup miss" — the reviewer's evidence drops the scoping clause, which is exactly the remedy the finding requests. The remaining clause ("Every emitter builds it through errorEnvelope / backendErrorEnvelope") is about emitters of the JSON error envelope defined two lines above, and it is true in this tree: the envelope shape is constructed only in formatter.ts:80-82 and 111-113, and every file that emits it (docs/import.ts, notes/import.ts, slides/import.ts, files/upload.ts, commands/schema.ts, formatter.ts:outputError) routes through those helpers — no hand-rolled envelope exists. The cited ctx.ts:61/67 and login.ts:73/90/107 bare messages are real, but they are session/auth human-facing messages that the same doc explicitly prescribes as plain text (cli.md:193-194, 246-247, 250, 267), so they do not contradict §9's scoped statement. At most this is a wording nit ("Every envelope emitter"), which is minor and non-blocking under this lens.

finding.summary: Many error envelopes bypass `outputError`, so they still emit multi-line pretty-printed JSON with no `command` — violating the newly-asserted §9 contract
finding.evidence: docs/design/cli.md §9 (line 1017-1018) and packages/cli/README.md:116-118 both state errors are "a single JSON line on stderr" with shape `{"error":{"code":"…","message":"…","command":"docs.content"}}`. The diff only changes `outputError`, but a large set of failure paths hand-roll their own envelope with `JSON.stringify(..., null, 2)` and no command: packages/cli/src/docs/import.ts:126-137 (CONFIRMATION_REQ — the exact code README:120 promises), :164, :194, :201, :211, :245; packages/cli/src/slides/import.ts:154, :194, :237, :244, :254, :312; packages/cli/src/notes/import.ts:122, :159, :188, :197, :212; packages/cli/src/files/upload.ts:217, :227 (`errorJson` helper); packages/cli/src/files/download.ts:57; packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts:195/:255/:307; packages/cli/src/commands/notes.ts:148/:203; packages/cli/src/commands/slides.ts:154/:204. A caller reading stderr with a line-delimited parser still breaks on these, and cannot attribute them.

verdict.reason: The finding claims failure paths hand-roll their own error envelope with `JSON.stringify(..., null, 2)` and no `command`, bypassing the §9 single-line contract. The repository shows the opposite. The exact instance cited as proof — the `CONFIRMATION_REQ` non-TTY gate in `packages/cli/src/docs/import.ts` — emits `errorEnvelope('CONFIRMATION_REQ', …, command)` (import.ts:143-152), which is the shared builder in `output/formatter.ts:75-83` producing compact single-line JSON with `command` merged in. `formatter.ts:66-74` explicitly documents that `errorEnvelope`/`backendErrorEnvelope` are exported precisely because `outputError` is not the only emitter (import/upload/download orchestrators, backend passthroughs, `schema` miss). Every other cited line routes through those builders: docs/import.ts:178/214/226/237/276, slides/import.ts:160/258/328, notes/import.ts:134/212, files/upload.ts:148/165/173/217, files/download.ts:63-69, commands/docs.ts:202-208 (+272, 376), commands/notes.ts:159/220/262, commands/slides.ts:165/222/262, commands/schema.ts:41-44 — all with `commandPath(this)` or a propagated `command`. No `errorJson` helper exists anywhere in packages/cli/src. The remaining pretty-printed `JSON.stringify(..., null, 2)` calls at the cited lines are stdout success/dry-run bodies, not error envelopes, so they are outside the §9 stderr contract. docs/design/cli.md:1035-1039 asserts this same invariant and the code matches it.
